fact: The Director General of Taxes, interviewed in L'Essor, cites the law on electronic transactions as part of a solid legal framework for digitalising public payments; the date of the law is not given, so the document's publication date is used.

Law n° 2016-012 of 6 May 2016 on electronic transactions, exchanges and services, published in the Journal officiel of 27 May 2016, regulates electronic commerce and gives legal effect to electronic writings, electronic signatures, electronic certificates and electronic archiving.
system: Loi n° 2016-012 relative aux Transactions, Echanges et Services électroniques

fact: Consumer protection law n°2015-036 of 16 July 2015 (published in the Journal officiel of 7 August 2015) sets rules for distance sales including by electronic means, bans email advertising without consent, and states that an electronic-form contract is validly concluded under the law on electronic exchange of legal data; it covers online selling only in part.
system: Loi n°2015-036 portant protection du consommateur
